label: practice

test_cases.label: contains() finds existing keys and rejects missing keys
test_cases.code:
t = BST()
for x in [4, 1, 3, 6, 7, 5, 8]: t.insert(x)
assert t.contains(4) is True and t.contains(5) is True and t.contains(8) is True
assert t.contains(0) is False and t.contains(2) is False and t.contains(9) is False

test_cases.label: height() returns 0 for empty, 1 for root, and proper depth
test_cases.code:
t = BST()
assert t.height() == 0
t.insert(4)
assert t.height() == 1
for x in [1, 3, 6, 7, 5, 8]: t.insert(x)
assert t.height() == 4

test_cases.label: __str__() formats '<>', '<3>', '<2, 3, 4>'
test_cases.code:
t = BST()
assert str(t) == '<>'
t.insert(3)
assert str(t) == '<3>'
t.insert(2)
t.insert(4)
assert str(t) == '<2, 3, 4>'

test_cases.label: to_list() returns sorted Python list
test_cases.code:
t = BST()
assert t.to_list() == []
for x in [4, 1, 3, 6, 7, 5, 8]: t.insert(x)
assert t.to_list() == [1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
